goal_evidence.interpretation: The back compartment is the rear half of the centrally divided pair, behind the transverse divider toward world -X, rather than either full-depth lateral compartment.
goal_evidence.visible_evidence: The actual pickup comparison showed the book lifted with the fingers. After release and vertical withdrawal, the current front image shows its pale page edge and black covers remaining upright behind the central transverse divider. The current wrist image independently shows the book contained within the rear central pocket, not bridging the divider or lying outside. The open fingers are well above and separated from the book, which remains supported inside the caddy.

agent_assessment.summary: Picked up the book and placed it upright in the caddy’s back central compartment, then released it and withdrew the gripper.
